title: Make settings easier to find
line: The Lock Keys widget now shows Num Lock status by default, not only Caps Lock.
explanation: The Lock Keys Status widget only watched Caps Lock by default; showing Num Lock needed an option in its settings, which are hard to find because the widget only appears in the tray while a watched key is on. Nate suggested making Num Lock a default too, since many laptops have no Num Lock light. The change makes the default key list 'Caps Lock,Num Lock', so the tray shows the widget whenever Num Lock is on.

commits.message:
applets/keyboardindicator: show Num Lock status by default

Many laptop keyboards have no Num Lock light, but the widget only showed
Caps Lock unless the user found the option in its settings. Add Num Lock
to the default list of keys, like Caps Lock, so its status is visible too.

BUG: 510352

patches.diff:
From 604494a6d523fd8bbf33734685aea8bd9d402b2a Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 16:46:52 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/keyboardindicator: show Num Lock status by default

Many laptop keyboards have no Num Lock light, but the widget only showed
Caps Lock unless the user found the option in its settings. Add Num Lock
to the default list of keys, like Caps Lock, so its status is visible too.

BUG: 510352
---
 applets/keyboardindicator/main.xml | 2 +-
 1 file changed, 1 insertion(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/keyboardindicator/main.xml b/applets/keyboardindicator/main.xml
index 19f7cf1b5..2b55a2528 100644
--- a/applets/keyboardindicator/main.xml
+++ b/applets/keyboardindicator/main.xml
@@ -7,7 +7,7 @@
 
   <group name="General">
     <entry name="key" type="StringList">
-      <default>Caps Lock</default>
+      <default>Caps Lock,Num Lock</default>
     </entry>
   </group>
 
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: Num Lock is on, but the system tray shows no Lock Keys icon
Num Lock is on and the tray shows the Num Lock icon
A new Lock Keys widget with Num Lock on: 'No lock keys activated'
A new Lock Keys widget with Num Lock on: 'Num Lock activated'

review.text: Clean one-line KConfig default change that follows Nate Graham's explicit direction in comment #3 to show Num Lock status by default alongside Caps Lock. It also avoids the duplicate-<default> bug from kdeplasma-addons!926 by using the comma-separated StringList syntax, preserving Caps Lock in the default list. Before/after screenshots and regression checks confirm both the System Tray indicator and standalone widget work as expected without breaking saved widget configs or hiding behavior when Num Lock is off.

reviews.text: Clean one-line KConfig default change that follows Nate Graham's explicit direction in comment #3 to show Num Lock status by default alongside Caps Lock. It also avoids the duplicate-<default> bug from kdeplasma-addons!926 by using the comma-separated StringList syntax, preserving Caps Lock in the default list. Before/after screenshots and regression checks confirm both the System Tray indicator and standalone widget work as expected without breaking saved widget configs or hiding behavior when Num Lock is off.

This is exactly the resolution Nate proposed in c3 and the reporter accepted, and the one-line change is correct: the comma-separated StringList default keeps Caps Lock (unlike the second <default> element in !926), which the after screenshots and tooltip confirm. Commit message, line and explanation match the patch, and widgets with a saved key list are unaffected. The trade-off to state in the MR: users who keep Num Lock on (most desktop keyboards with a numpad) and never changed the widget will now see a permanent Lock Keys icon in the tray, since anyActive includes numLockState; that follows from Nate's suggestion, but reviewers should sign off on it knowingly.
